title: Creation and Configuration of Projects and Settings
content:
Note this page is for IPEX DevOps team. All teams get a Azure DevOps project. To make configuration as simple as possible follow steps below that covers basic setup where team has contributor access to the two services we use i.e. Azure Pipelines and Azure Azure artifacts.

Create new project

Create project using standard settings i.e. surf to Projects - Home (azure.com) fill in name and description and hit create.

Configure project

Create a project and in the Project settings - Overview page:

  • Disable all services except Artifacts and Pipelines.

Figure: Project settings set during creation of project

Add Azure AD security group that is used to represent team to Azure DevOps team to enable simple management of team. Configuration is done in project settings - teams page. Figure below shows configuration for IPEX Home Smart team.

Create Artifact feed

When setting up a project in Azure DevOps, a key thing is to set up the Artifacts feed. Under the projects landing page you can find Artifacts in the sidebar.

On the Artifacts page, click Create Feed.

The following prompt will appear:

Use the default values for Visibility, Upstream sources and scope. Fill in the name of the feed in lower case. The name should be the same as your solution, for example: skytta or kvadrat. Click Create.

The feed is now created. Go to Upstream sources and delete the upstreams not needed. This generally means to delete NuGet Gallery, PyPI and Maven Central.

Click + Add upstream source to set up the IPEX dependencies.

Click Azure Artifacts feed in s organization. Add the feeds needed for the project. Currently the base packages are KOMPIS, CORE and VIEWER. Core and Viewer are hosted under the storage-one-feed for now. When you are done it should look like below.

Go to the Permissions tab. Here you will add the development/technical lead of the project as an Owner of the feed.

Do note that for people to be able to be found and assigned roles they need to have logged in to Azure DevOps at least once.

Head to the Feed details tab. At the bottom check the Enable retention policies checkbox. Use the default values for now. Ensure that you press the Save button.

Pipelines and Github Actions

If the project is using Azure Pipelines, access for the build agents are set by default. If using Github actions, the service account needs to be granted access to the project. Level of permission required depends on if the project is a publisher or a consumer.

Publishing project

If the project is publishing projects that will be consumed by other projects, grant the service account contributor access.

Also add the teams security group as a member of the Artifact consumer group.

Finally add the Artifact counsumer group to the READERS group in the project.

Consumer project

Add the teams security group as a member of the Artifact consumer group.
